featured_dragon.name: High Falalute Dragon
featured_dragon.description: This dragon never stays in one place long enough to be forgotten, but long enough to leave a song behind. Equal parts rogue and rockstar, it roams the dragon world with a battered guitar and a grin that says it has already won before the battle begins.

rewards.name: Coin Holder Dragon
rewards.description: During the Shadow Council's 'temporary' reign, every dragon must pay a safety tax to thank them for keeping the ungoverned lands safe... The Coin Holder Dragon ensures this Gold is spent wisely. Just don't ask him about their luxury robes and banquets.

rewards.name: Flame Virago Dragon
rewards.description: With her fiery bow and arrow and a fierce dedication to the Virago force, the Flame Virago Dragon is a loyal and headstrong warrior. Her selfless values are an example to live by, many look up to her.

rewards.name: Dwarf Dragon
rewards.description: The Dwarf Dragon has always been a fearsome fighter. He has been wielding his trusty axe ever since he was little and now most dragons tend to stay clear from his powerful blows! Being an explorer at heart, what Island will he conquer next?

featured_dragon.name: Gel Barrier Dragon
featured_dragon.description: Little critters in Dragon City have found solace in the Gel Barrier Dragon as they are immune to his toxic touch. However, this creature is one of the toughest and most venomous around. One attack from him and his enemies will disintegrate.

rewards.name: Glass Angel Dragon
rewards.description: Peer into her delicate glass body to see your reflection floating in an ocean of iridescent colors... The Glass Angel Dragon will give you the inspiration and self-confidence you need to slay the day! Cool, calm, and collected, she's a favorite to beat the Guardian Gauntet.

rewards.name: Genemancer Dragon
rewards.description: An expert geneticist, the Genemancer Dragon's tests have resulted in a series of dragon clones. His goal? To create the perfect dragon. Sometimes his experiments go right and sometimes they go wrong...

rewards.name: Gelatin Dragon
rewards.description: The Gelatin Dragon might look scary, but he’s one of the sweetest dragons around…literally. This gooey dragon’s fruit-flavored skin contains enough sugar to knock out any opponent.
